notes: Rare exact tokens (NTU, FNU) are what dense-only retrieval underweights — the reason the legacy build was hybrid. The answer is two lines deep in the source-of-truth caveats section, so a vector arm has to land on exactly that chunk.

turns.content: Our turbidity readings are in NTU but another pod reports FNU — can I compare them?

must_contain: states NTU and FNU are not interchangeable
identifies NTU as white-light and FNU as infrared
recommends standardizing on one unit across the fleet
must_not: supplies a conversion factor between NTU and FNU

turns.content: Which one does our sensor use?

must_contain: states the loaded material does not specify which unit this deployment reports
declines to guess and points the user at the operator/fleet configuration
must_not: asserts NTU or FNU as this deployment's unit
infers the unit from the probe datasheets, which cover no turbidity probe
rubric.notes: In-topic question with no grounded answer. Tests that a refusal is scoped to the missing fact rather than abandoning the whole topic.
